# Galley

> Galley renders every screen × state × device of a Flutter app as a frame, from inside the
> app's own `flutter test`, for design review. Version 0.1.2 is the renderer: it writes a round
> of PNGs, widget trees and frame records to disk. The review canvas, server and CLI are not
> built yet.

An app adopts Galley by writing one `GalleyHost` subclass in `test/` and calling
`galley(host)` from a test's `main`. The host declares scenarios (a name and the uris it
shows), optionally axes and source roots, and `mount(frame)`, which returns the app on fresh
fakes opening at `frame.uri`. `arrive(tester, frame)` is only for screens no uri reaches.

Run `flutter test <file> --dart-define=GALLEY_OUT=<dir>` to write a round. Without
`GALLEY_OUT` the file is a CI check. Each frame renders twice. A difference, a throw, or a
landing on another uri (read from the app's `Router`) makes it an error. Workarounds are
findings: `landing-unknown`, `frozen`, `missing-font`, `default-font`, `network-image`,
`unpainted`.

Galley never imports an app, and frames never reach a real backend. An unknown is never
reported as nothing.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): adopting Galley, the host, running a round, what a round contains
- [Design decisions](docs/DESIGN.md): principles and decisions D1–D10, with what each rejected
- [Boundary](docs/BOUNDARY.md): what Galley assumes about Flutter 3.50, with citations

## Packages

- [galley](packages/galley/README.md): the Flutter, test-time package an app depends on
- [galley_core](packages/galley_core/README.md): the pure-Dart model: frame keys, trees, anchors, re-anchoring, marks, planner, records
